clue.text: Success with aid for winter tourists lacking first independence and right to travel freely

parts.note: a hit is a success, as a hit record

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: a chairlift carries skiers up the slopes

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of independence

explanation.surface: A ski-resort advert promising a successful holiday, minus the independence and freedom it seems to offer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' removes two letters, the first of 'independence' and the abbreviation for 'right', from the ski lift, and 'with' joins the result to the word for success.
explanation.definitionFit: To thumb a ride from passing drivers is a free way of getting about, an idiom for travelling without paying.

clue.text: Crank's commonly used name

definitions.meaning: a crank is a starting ... on an old car
an informal name or nickname, as used by radio hams

explanation.surface: An eccentric's nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a lever turned by hand; the other is slang for a person's name.

clue.text: Irregular troops made advances to

parts.note: the TA, the Territorial Army, is Britain's reserve force of part-time soldiers
lent means made loans, advances of money

explanation.surface: Part-time soldiers flirting with someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made advances to' looks like flirting, but in the wordplay it means lent money; the whole clue then describes the attractive people soldiers chat up.
explanation.definitionFit: The local talent is slang for attractive people, the ones a soldier on leave would try to pick up.

clue.text: Hospital treated godfather with case of impetigo giving repeated dose

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

indicators.note: treated means processed or worked on, so these letters are rearranged
the case of a word is its outside, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A patient's godfather is treated in hospital for a skin infection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case of impetigo' gives I and O, which join GODFATHER as anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A drink taken to cure a hangover repeats the drink that caused it, so it is a further dose of the same.

clue.text: Boy goes with Yankee dame

parts.note: a lad is a boy
Yankee is the NATO alphabet word for Y

explanation.surface: A boy dating an American woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame and lady are both titles and words for a woman of rank.

clue.text: It provides beam, sort of wood — length used in stairs

indicators.note: used in means placed within, so these letters go inside the stairs

parts.note: a flight is a set of stairs
ash is a type of timber

explanation.surface: A carpenter's note: a wooden beam is built into a staircase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beam' suggests a joist, aided by 'wood' and 'stairs', but is a ray of light.
explanation.definitionFit: A torch produces a beam of light, so it is described by what it gives out.

clue.text: Join an objection

parts.note: the indefinite article an gives A
a but is an objection, as in no ifs or buts

explanation.surface: An invitation to join in raising a protest.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things that adjoin or border each other touch, so to join here means to lie next to.

clue.text: Scotch bonnet needs something to soothe pain in the mouth

parts.note: a balm is a soothing ointment
oral means of or in the mouth

explanation.surface: Someone who ate a hot Scotch bonnet chilli needs relief for a burning mouth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scotch bonnet' looks like the fiery chilli pepper but is a Scottish cap.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat brimless Scottish cap, named after the royal castle, is a kind of bonnet.

clue.text: Vegetables and meats too in the soup

indicators.note: in the soup means in a mess, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A recipe: vegetables and meat both go into the soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the soup' reads as cooking but is the idiom for being in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanically fruit, these are treated in cooking as vegetables.

clue.text: Song in North-East — spare a music hall one

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation for North-East

indicators.note: in places the song inside the following letters

parts.note: spare means thin, lean
a lied is a German art song

explanation.surface: A songwriter in the North-East offers up a spare old music hall number.
explanation.walkthrough: LIED goes inside NE + LEAN, after its L. 'one' in the definition stands for song.
explanation.definitionFit: Nellie Dean is a well-known Edwardian music hall ballad, so it is an example of such a number.

clue.text: State true choice

indicators.note: to state something is to say it out loud, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: plumb means exactly vertical, true

explanation.surface: A demand to say which option is the right one.
explanation.definitionFit: A plum job is a choice one, the best of the bunch, so the adjective sense matches.

clue.text: Criminal can do worst to crime-fighter

indicators.note: criminal suggests something bent or wrong, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A villain can do the worst possible to a detective.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherlock Holmes's companion helps solve crimes, so he is a fictional crime-fighter.

clue.text: Novelist left dealing with teacher

parts.note: on means about, dealing with
a don is a university teacher

explanation.surface: A writer who has walked out on a teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: Jack London wrote The Call of the Wild, so he is an example of a novelist.

clue.text: Armed conflict to drive away solicitor

parts.note: shoo is what one says or does to drive animals away
a tout solicits custom; the clue plays on the legal sense

explanation.surface: A violent clash used to get rid of a lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solicitor' looks like a lawyer but here means one who solicits business, a tout.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunfight between two sides is a brief armed conflict.

clue.text: They may deter a murder

parts.note: a murder is the collective noun for a flock of crows, which figures in fields are set up to frighten off

explanation.surface: Something that might prevent a killing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'murder' reads as a killing but is the collective noun for crows.
explanation.definitionFit: Straw figures in fields keep birds such as crows away from crops.

clue.text: Kindest actor deployed standard resources

indicators.note: troops deployed are spread out and rearranged, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A generous actor puts their usual repertoire to work.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the goods or skills a trader or person routinely relies on, their usual resources.

clue.text: Parliament's rage over introduction of tax

parts.note: to storm is to rage
on can mean over, as in a book on a subject

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: MPs are furious about a new tax being brought in.
explanation.definitionFit: Stormont is the seat of the Northern Ireland Assembly, so it stands for that parliament.

clue.text: Model office worker delayed

parts.note: a temp is a temporary office worker
late means delayed

explanation.surface: An exemplary office worker who nonetheless turns up late.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern used as a guide for copying is a model.

clue.text: The people here that are shooting cowboy film

parts.note: these refers to the people right here
archers are people shooting arrows

explanation.surface: A film crew on location for a western, pointing at the actors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shooting' suggests filming, but means shooting arrows.
explanation.definitionFit: The Searchers is John Ford's 1956 western starring John Wayne, an example of a cowboy film.

clue.text: Function takes hour in holy place

indicators.note: takes means takes in, so the function holds the hour inside

parts.note: sine is a trigonometric function

explanation.surface: A religious ceremony lasts an hour in a sacred spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Function' suggests a ceremony but is the mathematical sine.
explanation.definitionFit: A site of devotion to a saint or god is a sacred place.

clue.text: Benefit for able-bodied

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
fit means healthy, able-bodied

explanation.surface: A welfare payment for those well enough to work.
explanation.definitionFit: Gain or advantage from something is a benefit.

clue.text: Criticise scope restricting expert

indicators.note: restricting means hemming in, so the first word surrounds the second

parts.note: reach means range, scope
a pro is an expert

explanation.surface: A complaint that limiting the remit of a specialist is wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuke someone is to find fault with them, a close synonym.

clue.text: Turner watercolour finally creates a stir

parts.note: a lathe turns wood or metal

indicators.note: finally asks for the last letter of watercolour

explanation.surface: A painting by J. M. W. Turner causes a sensation in the art world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turner' looks like the painter, aided by 'watercolour', but is a machine that turns.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a lather is to be in an agitated state, a fuss or stir.

clue.text: Malevolent spirit creating endless danger

indicators.note: endless means without its final letter

parts.note: peril means danger

explanation.surface: An evil ghost causing unending danger.
explanation.definitionFit: In Persian myth a peri was a supernatural being, originally thought of as an evil one.

clue.text: How to address a Knight of the Round Table correctly

parts.note: O is the old vocative, used when addressing someone

parts.words: a Knight of the Round Table
parts.note: Sir Kay is one of King Arthur's knights

explanation.surface: A point of etiquette: the proper way to speak to one of Arthur's knights.
explanation.definitionFit: Done all right, acceptably, is a loose sense of correctly.

clue.text: Suffering tedium of deb first coming out

indicators.note: coming out suggests emerging in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A debutante finds her first society ball rather dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Being extremely uninterested and weary describes someone suffering tedium.

clue.text: Person who restrains a row

definitions.meaning: one who ties things up or down
a level or rank, as in seating

explanation.surface: Someone holding back a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is someone who binds; the other is a level or rank of seats.

clue.text: Agree with Ming toiling in task

indicators.note: in places the scrambled letters inside the other word

parts.note: to assent is to agree

indicators.note: toiling suggests hard churning work, so the name's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Consenting to Ming, a labourer hard at work on a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'toiling' scrambles the name to IGNM, and 'in' places those four letters inside the word for agree, after its first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of work set for someone is a job or task.
